decision: (a) qfd_res_train_static (Codex fixed train24 banks + 64 head markers, codex/qwen-producer-train-1103 b752dd7d4)
rule: accepted-cost ledger (owner 2026-10-13): measured, <=5% e2e per unit; candidates compared on the same actual producer timing
method: tb_sertrade.sv: actual ot_qwen_me_spctl_w12 + ot_qwen_me_spport_w12 (Codex extraction, sha-pinned) execute every result-producing ME instruction of the shipped decoder programme (cc5bc8fc..., PCs 1/11/12/16/20 decoded with tools/hdc_qwen_fullshape_isa_w12.py); the captures are replayed cycle-exactly into 3 bands of (a) and of (b). (b) is run twice: on the actual timing and on a hypothetical producer that holds capture k to max(actual_k, capture_{k-1}+24), the spacing (b) requires.

layer.b_on_actual_producer: SCHEDULE FAULT on every op (8 captures 1 edge apart vs required >= 24): not executable without new producer RTL
layer.b_spaced_requires: per-train hold of 8 x 4425-bit bursts inside the ME spine port (the same storage as (a), moved into closed ME tiles) or a 3x slower final IL round; no such RTL exists

area.note: ~0.1 mm2 FF cell area (+mux/placement ~0.2 mm2) per compute die = ~0.02% of 841 mm2; 72 bank clock roots x 4,975 sinks (< 15k rule)

ledger.face_vs_price: COMMON TO BOTH: the static result face (one 551-b band beat per VM cycle, fixed 24 slots per burst incl. empty rows) adds 1445 cycles/layer over an unconstrained face; token-path model (accepted_cost.py, node-delta per op) qkv 2.27% + o_proj 6.89% + gate_up 2.27% + down 6.09% = ~15.6% e2e (+PC11 ~17%), over the 5% unit limit -> structural VM result-face successor required (not a serializer choice)
structural_options: 3 band result ports into the VM in parallel (8 cycles/burst): est. +293 cycles/layer (~4% e2e) from the same measured captures
row-compressed calendar: the compiler knows each burst we-mask (nout/tiles/split); reserve only real rows (TP8 rows/layer qkv 48, o_proj 256, gate_up 192, down 256 vs 192/576/192/576 slots)

finding_pc11: PC11 (me_wsrc=1, me_mmode=1, VM-sourced weights) also emits 8 captures; Codex profile list (64/layer) omitted it; (a) accepts it as count=1, stride>=8, payload=1 (a_fault 000)
bit_order: slab qfd_port_tiles_b.rq = {slot s {addr24,mask16,data512} @552s, we[7:0]@4416, ov@4424}; qfd_res_train_static.rq uses the same packing (tb_sertrade replays slab-packed bursts; exact rows/masks); the legacy qfd_sp_res_ser.i order {data,mask,addr,we@1,ov@0} must never take rq directly -- die contracts binding qfd_port_tiles_b.rq -> qfd_sp_res_ser.i (c8..c17 relay_run) are functionally wrong and are superseded by rq -> qfd_res_train_static.rq
limits: synthetic slot replication: the one actual port fills all 8 slots/3 bands (we=1); real per-band we masks only reduce real rows, the static calendar reserves all 24 slots either way
priced op cycles are the TP4-basis measured prices used by tools/throughput/accepted_cost.py (TP8 conservative delta 0)
component scope: no slab physical, no native programme issuer binding of train_start/count/stride

link_handoff.note: bench edge convention of tb_sertrade (cycle index observed after the edge); relative to the ME instruction go edge of the actual controller profile; the layer calendar adds each op go age. Captures = actual producer; landings = qfd_res_train_static band-2 end beats measured. Burst k band b slot j is on the rb pins 24k+8b+j-16 edges before its end beat.
